newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Yankee fully restores 510 MW power plant.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Yankee fully restores 510 MW power plant.

text.p: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp restored the 510 megawatt (MW) Vermont Yankee nuclear generating station to full power, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday in its daily status report.
The company trimmed the plant's output to 80 percent of capacity for several days to repair a condensate pump seal leak.
Market sources cited reduced production from Vermont Yankee as a factor supporting spot electricity prices for the past couple days in the New England Power Pool.

Vermont Yankee in Vernon, Vt., is owned by a consortium of New England utilities including Central Vermont Public Service Co, New England Electric System, Green Mountain Power, Northeast Utilities and Central Maine Power Co.
